pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 50 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1250 °C·d$(). Best near 28 °C; stops above 40 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -1.5 °C (-1 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7 (tolerates 5.2-8). Roots 1 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 230, P 25, K 120 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 60% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 45 bu/ac (3 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Soybeans.
